scope: exploratory matched simulation-only versus offline video-guided robot imitation; not human 3D recovery or original A/B/C/D ablation
normalization: same shared engineering observation ranges; delta action XYZ scale 8mm per axis, width scale32.5mm; no heldout statistics

model.rgb_encoder: three stride-2 5x5 CNNs, GroupNorm/SiLU, spatial 4x4 pooling, 64D feature
model.initialization: same full model initial weights for paired seed
model.type: 128D GRU over current 64D RGB encoding and 12D robot/goal input; tanh 4D delta/width head

training.sampling: uniform whole episodes; all valid timestep targets; zero hidden state per episode
training.selection: all fixed final EMA checkpoints; validation reporting only, no best seed or checkpoint
training.objective: masked MSE on normalized current EE delta and desired gripper width
training.budget_comparison: equal within the two v3 conditions; full-episode recurrent BC differs in targets/compute from diffusion revisions, no equal-budget cross-architecture claim

validation.purpose: closed-loop development check on shared validation scene IDs

evaluation.scoring: same strict designated-goal physics; fixed horizon, scorer does not terminate/repair policy
evaluation.goals: pairs cycled P1G1 through P4G4; not arbitrary/unseen goal claims
evaluation.main_suite_gate: run shared 8-scene validation for all six models first; if either condition has zero successes across all three seeds, retain failure and leave independent suites unexecuted while diagnosing a new revision

status: frozen before policy training or evaluation
action_semantics: teacher effective XYZ command minus same pre-action robot EE XYZ; future labels use their corresponding future teacher robot state; deployment adds each predicted delta to current measured EE
revision_reason: short-history diffusion development rollouts showed missed grasp/phase transitions; evaluate deterministic causal recurrent imitation as a separate architecture
memory: learned recurrent hidden state is updated from past/current inputs; it can encode temporal information, but no absolute clock or expert phase is supplied
